Since P_n(x) = P_{n-1}(x − n), applying this repeatedly gives P_21(x) = P_0(x − S), where S = 1 + 2 + … + 21 = 231.

The coefficient of x in P_0(x − 231) is P_0'(−231), because shifting the argument by a constant makes the linear coefficient equal to the derivative at the shifted point.

P_0'(x) = 3x² + 426x − 67

At x = −231:
- 3 · 231² = 3 · 53361 = 160083
- 426 · (−231) = −98406
- the constant term is −67

Sum: 160083 − 98406 − 67 = 61610

ANSWER: 61610
